company.name: Swish
company.shortDescription: Swish is a fintech company that provides mobile payment services.
company.description:
Swish aggregates the best pre-orders from across the internet. Most of the products you see are being sold by other websites. If you see something you like, you can click through and purchase on that website. Swish has no particular relationship with these sites, they just link to them. Sometimes they write us thank-you notes.

Some of the products are sold by Swish directly. Look for their rocket logo to recognize Swish direct products. When you check out on Swish.com, your purchase is guaranteed. You'll receive the item within a year or your money back.

Is Swish crowdfunding? Not quite. However, tons of great products are available for pre-order on crowdfunding websites.
